extraction.Name: St.John Benjamin Oliver
extraction.Refused/Protested: patents in fee were issued prior to the year 1921, covering their allotments, and inherited lands, during the trust period, without their applications therefor
extraction.NOTES: Document is a cover letter dated January 23, 1930 from Superintendent H.E. Wright, Crow Creek Agency, submitting an alphabetical list of Indians under Circular No. 2464 to whom patents in fee were issued prior to 1921 without their applications. Other allottees listed in the same document: Little Eagle Edward No. 800, Shields George Lewis No. 404, St. John Joseph No. 574, St. John Peter No. 547, Walker William No. 546, Carpenter William No. 18, Carpenter Victoria No. 37, Dougherty Louisa No. 881, Dougherty Dolly No. 1350, Fallis Cleveland No. 1350, Irving Daniel No. 55 L.B., Jacobs Henry No. 1400, Carpenter Amelia No. 882, Carpenter Lary Wickem No. 143.
